test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six teachers are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Ruhi is sitting second to the left of Sophie. Gautam is sitting third to the right of Dinesh. Preeti is an immediate neighbour of both Sophie and Gautam. Mary is sitting to the immediate left of Ruhi. Who is an immediate neighbour of both Ruhi and Sophie?
solution:
Given → Six teachers are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1)Ruhi is sitting second to the left of Sophie. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78f744f0223900dcca2b3a42d123d32e168fc620da76f0e0e6bc67ca3e9fb3e4.png] 

2) Preeti is an immediate neighbour of both Sophie and Gautam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46f040aa0b697fb665be835fecf3d8a392484a47ba956f249731e15b70c150b1.png] 

3) Mary is sitting to the immediate left of Ruhi. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2b85fe12a0c0162bfdf2449849b60346b509193e94a1f3e2666bd37223d9691.png] 

4) Gautam is sitting third to the right of Dinesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e2bbbb121dbfe7779e47c4cc7fb02c2047f98d5f9f1444c7f7e71bc2f126cb7.png] 

Therefore,it is established that Dinesh is an immediate neighbour of both Ruhi and Sophie.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Dinesh".**
